title: Tabular Foundation Models in Financial Predictions
abstract: arXiv:2611.13550v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This technical note introduces tabular foundation models (TFMs) to accounting research and evaluates their performance in one common benchmark task: predicting firms' next-year earnings changes. TFMs produce numeric predictions and learn in context, without post-release training or tuning, making them natural and easy to use for forecasting. The TFMs we study are pretrained on synthetic tabular data, so they avoid look-ahead bias from memorizing firms' outcomes. We compare Google Research's TabFM with a fine-tuned open-weight large language model developed in recent accounting research and with several tree-based models. TabFM is more accurate than all comparison models. It is also faster and less computationally intensive than the large language model. Several tree-based specifications produce predictions more quickly than TabFM, so choosing between them involves a trade-off between accuracy and speed. We conclude that TFMs have promise

translated_title: 金融预测中的表格基础模型
translated_abstract: 本技术简报将表格基础模型（TFMs）引入会计研究，并评估其在一项常见基准任务中的表现：预测公司下一年的盈利变化。TFMs 能生成数值预测并通过上下文进行学习，无需发布后的训练或调优，使其在预测应用中自然而易于使用。我们研究的 TFMs 在合成表格数据上进行预训练，因此避免了因记忆公司结果而产生的前瞻偏差。我们将 Google Research 的 TabFM 与近期会计研究中开发的微调开源权重大型语言模型以及若干基于树的模型进行比较。结果表明，TabFM 比所有对比模型都更准确，同时比大型语言模型更快、计算强度更低。虽然若干基于树的模型生成预测的速度比 TabFM 更快，但在它们之间进行选择需要在准确性和速度之间进行权衡。我们得出结论，TFMs 具有广阔的应用前景。
tldr: 表格基础模型（TFMs）在预测公司下一年盈利变化方面优于微调大语言模型和基于树的模型，同时更快且计算成本更低，是会计研究中具有前景的预测工具。
en_tdlr: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) outperform fine-tuned large language models and tree-based models in predicting firms' next-year earnings changes, while being faster and less computationally intensive than LLMs, showing promise for accounting research.
